subject: general
question: Birsa Munda hockey stadium is one of the India’s largest hockey stadium. In which state is this stadium situated?
solution:
The correct answer is **Odisha**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium** is located in Rourkela, Odisha.
 
• It is one of the largest hockey stadiums in India.
 
• The stadium is named after the tribal freedom fighter **Birsa Munda**.
 
• It is a key venue for national and international hockey tournaments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Location**
 The stadium is situated in **Rourkela**, Odisha.
 
 

 **Capacity**
 It has a seating capacity of approximately **20,000** spectators.
 
 

 **Significance**
 Named after **Birsa Munda**, a tribal freedom fighter and folk hero.
 
 

 **Events**
 Hosts national and international **hockey tournaments**.
